item.title: Vanessa Williams Says Two Music Legends Passed on ‘Save the Best for Last’ Before It Came Her Way: ‘I Was Third One Up’
item.description:
Here's a short, engaging podcast script based on the article:
[Upbeat music fades out, and the host's voice comes on]
Host: "Welcome to this week's episode of Trending on Billboard! Today, we're diving into the fascinating story behind Vanessa Williams' signature hit, 'Save the Best for Last'. You might be surprised to know that this soulful pop ballad could have sounded completely different, and it's all because of the artists who were offered the song before Vanessa Williams."
[Soft music plays in the background]
Host: "According to Vanessa Williams, she was actually the third artist to be offered 'Save the Best for Last'. The song was initially sent to none other than Bette Midler, who passed on it, and then it was offered to the legendary Barbra Streisand, who also declined. Can you imagine how different the song would have sounded with either of these icons behind the mic?"
[Music transitions to a brief clip of "Save the Best for Last"]
Host: "Vanessa Williams eventually selected the song for her second studio album, The Comfort Zone, and it became a staple of her music career. 'Save the Best for Last' spent five weeks at number one on the Hot 100, earning two Grammy nominations and becoming one of the biggest hits of 1992."
[Music transitions back to the host]
Host: "But that's not all - Vanessa Williams also revealed that she wished she could have recorded Amy Grant's hit song 'Baby Baby', which topped the Hot 100 for two weeks in 1991. Unfortunately, the song was never brought to her attention, and it's a fascinating 'what if' moment in music history."
[Music fades out, and the host wraps up the episode]
Host: "That's all for today's episode of Trending on Billboard. Vanessa Williams' music career is a testament to her talent and versatility, with hits like 'The Comfort Zone', 'Colors of the Wind', and of course, 'Save the Best for Last'. Join us next time for more behind-the-scenes stories and fascinating facts from the world of music."
